span.p:
Page renderer
turns each PDF page or photo
into a JPEG image

div.style: color: rgb(66, 32, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Question prompts
the instructions for each
question type

div.style: color: rgb(66, 32, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Answer checker
(normalize_response) parses the
model's JSON and checks it against
the required answer format

div.style: color: rgb(66, 32, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Excel writer
writes submission.xlsx in
the competition's format

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1. Prepare each document once
page images (baseline renderer) and,
when usable, the PDF text layer: the
text and word positions stored in the PDF

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. Write each question's task
the baseline prompt, with file names
replaced by 该文档 ('this document'),
and how to submit through answer

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. Start one sandbox per question
16 at a time; 25 turns plus one
answer-only turn; 30 minutes each;
answers already paid for are reused

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4. Check and record
the baseline checker runs again
on answer.json; one record
per question

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5. Retry and stop rules
one more pass for questions without
an answer; no new questions after
8 failures in a row

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6. Write the results
submission.xlsx (baseline Excel
writer) and a cost report

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Input folder, read only
page images, text layer,
the question's task

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AI agent (pi, an open-source
coding agent)
tools: zoom (crop and enlarge a page
area), answer (check with a copy of the
baseline checker, then save and stop), run
commands (bash), read and write files

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Output folder, writable
answer.json and the
full conversation
